confidence_notes: Anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of tourist-area pricing in Lombok and Bali. They were not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation. The wine_glass anchor is the least certain and was set relative to beer and cocktail levels because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value 0.6955 comes from search-result summaries attributing it to the RBA's 15 Oct 2026 4pm rate. I did not open the RBA page directly, and the same results showed a different figure (0.7002) for 14 Oct with jumbled labels, so the value should be verified on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Bali's tourist-zone price levels, adjusted downward for Lombok's generally lower prices and smaller resort market. Senggigi and Kuta (Lombok) were used as reference resort zones.
